description: Export every product from one or more Shopify stores (or a single collection) via the store's public products feed: title, vendor, type, tags, min/max price, compare-at price, sale percentage, stock, variants with SKUs, and images. Use it for competitor price monitoring, catalog research, dropshipping/product sourcing or sale detection on any Shopify shop. Runs the Apify Actor loudtzu/shopify-store-products on your own Apify account (pay per event: $0.0005 per run + $0.00019 per product, billed by Apify; Apify platform usage may apply). Store page: https://apify.com/loudtzu/shopify-store-products

includeDescription.description: Include description. Add the product description as plain text (emails and phone numbers removed).

includeVariants.description: Include variants. Add a 'variants' list (size/colour, SKU, price, compare-at price, availability) to each product.

maxProductsPerStore.description: Max products per store. Stop after this many products from each store (default 100, max 50,000).

runOptions.description: Optional run limits (not passed to the Actor). maxTotalChargeUsd caps what this single call can cost you on Apify.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Hard cap in USD for this run's Actor charges. Defaults to the server's MAX_CHARGE_USD (1.00 unless set).

timeoutSecs.description: Run timeout in seconds (Apify's synchronous limit is 300).

storeUrls.description: Store URLs. One Shopify store per line, e.g. 'https://www.allbirds.com' or 'shop.example.com'. Add '/collections/<name>' to read just that collection. Empty lines stop the run before anything is charged. If you leave this out, the Actor reads allbirds.com. Example: ["https://www.allbirds.com"]

name: shopify_store_products
title: Shopify store product export
